name: Kioku Soushitsu no Okaa-san
source:
Atsushi's father died when he was young, and since then, he has lived together with his mother, Yayoi. He loves her as a woman, but she only sees him as her son.

One day he receives a call from the hospital. Yayoi had an accident and now has amnesia. When he arrives at the hospital, he introduces himself to Yayoi as her lover.
translation:
Atsushi的父亲在他年幼时就去世了，从那时起，他就和母亲弥生一起生活。他爱她作为一个女人，但她只把他视为她的儿子。

有一天，他接到医院打来的电话。弥生出了事故，现在失忆了。当他到达医院时，他向弥生介绍自己是她的情人。
